about.title: About Virani Roofing Service
text: A Class B general builder working two Northern California markets, with the office in Sacramento and crews across the Bay Area. Here is who you are actually hiring.

The distinction that matters most to a homeowner is this: we do the work. A great deal of residential construction in California is sold by one company and performed by whoever was available that week. When you hire us, the people on site are our own licensed crews, the permits are pulled by us rather than by you, and the person who priced the job is the person you call when you have a question about it.

We work in two markets because they are genuinely different jobs. Sacramento is a heat-and-soil market: triple-digit summers, expansive clay, larger lots and wider scopes. The Bay Area is an age-and-access market: pre-war housing, hillside lots, serious plan check and no room to park a skip. Pricing, scheduling and detailing all change between the two, so we keep them as separate operations rather than pretending one set of assumptions covers both.
